goal: Every commit the pr strategy pushes beyond the PR base carries the harness-derived Flywheel trailers before the pull request is opened or refreshed.

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/pr.py -- GitPullRequestSubmitter._submit (stamp between the protected-paths check and the push), _ensure_pr, the injectable GhRunner seam for tests
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- reuse the stamping engine and trailer constants the prerequisite task exported; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_pr_strategy.py -- keep green, assertions unmodified; also the stub-gh harness pattern to mirror
constraints: Stamp the pushed range (pr_base..branch) with the same shared trailer constants and value derivation as the merge path -- no second vocabulary
Stamping precedes the push, and the push precedes PR create/edit; the branch on the remote never lacks trailers while a PR references it
Message-only rewrite with trees byte-identical, same as the merge path
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change the PR body rendering (render_pr_body) or PR title format
Do not change park semantics (protected-paths, push-failed) on the pr path
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in test_pr_strategy.py
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: The refresh path (an open PR already exists, gh pr edit) also pushes stamped commits -- both create and refresh flows covered
The push already uses --force-with-lease; the stamp's history rewrite must not turn a first push into a failure
A forged Flywheel-Run trailer on a pushed commit is replaced, same as the merge path
